proof_summary: Lucas congruences split the relevant sums into two blocks whose terms cancel, giving vanishing for all indices strictly above the Hankel anti-diagonal; for the second family, complementary central-binomial factors provide the cancellation, while at index \(p-1\) only the midpoint survives. Thus both Hankel matrices are anti-triangular modulo \(p\); evaluating their constant anti-diagonals and the reversal-permutation sign \((-1)^{\binom p2}\) yields the two claimed determinant residues, with the signs canceling in the second case.
